about.title: About Car's Energy Co.
about.subtitle: Engineering integrity, certified conversions, and over 26 years of dedicated alternative fuel leadership in Delhi-NCR.
about.missionText: To deliver safe, reliable, and fuel-efficient alternative propulsion systems to vehicle owners while strictly conforming to national environmental and safety directives. We combine mechanical precision, computer diagnostics, and authenticated hardware.

values.title: Zero Compromise on Safety
values.desc: Every fitting undergoes high-pressure nitrogen/air leak checks and strict torque verification.

values.title: Technical Transparency
values.desc: We inspect before advising, clearly explain ECU fuel mapping, and never sell counterfeit parts.

values.title: Regulatory Conformance
values.desc: Authorized RFC Code 261 center with legitimate RTO registration support.

values.title: Long-Term Engine Health
values.desc: Calibrated to prevent cylinder head valve recession and preserve factory drivability.

about.workshopsIntro: Operating two strategically located facilities in New Delhi equipped with multi-gas analysers, cylinder hydro-testing tanks, and OBD-II calibration rigs.
